column1: # Shared time resolution cases (docs/concepts/time.md) for Python (python/tests/unit_test_time_resolution.py) and
# C++ (cpp/src/tests/test_TimeResolution.cc), on SQLite, MySQL and MariaDB. scripts/time/make_time_db.py writes the
# data into a database; every engine and both languages must give the expected value for every query.
# assignment<TAB>value<TAB>variation<TAB>created (UTC, microseconds)     rows in insertion order: ids grow down the list
# query<TAB>zone<TAB>request<TAB>expected value, or NONE when no assignment resolves
# The table is /test/time/values (one int column, one row); every assignment covers all runs, and its value names it.
# The variation child inherits from default. Two assignments, 102 and 103, share one microsecond: the later
# insert (higher id) wins at every limit at or after it.
